quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: in 2025 the company's new-infrastructure smart temperature-control product manufacturing base in Shunde, Guangdong formally went into production, with a liquid-cooling test center, liquid-cooling long-run platform, clean workshop and smart production lines that the company says will greatly raise liquid-cooling R&D testing, manufacturing and delivery capacity. The base's project (new-infrastructure smart temperature-control equipment intelligent manufacturing project, funded by raised funds and other sources) had a budget of RMB 679,895,100.00, with RMB 562,872,395.89 transferred to fixed assets in 2025 and project progress 99.63% at year-end. The Gaozhou, Guangdong special air-conditioning and ventilation equipment base phase 1 went into production on June 28, 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D investment RMB 192,166,689.00 in 2025 (+12.63%), 4.57% of revenue, none capitalized; 756 R&D staff. Data-center R&D projects in progress include an AI integrated air-liquid CDU, an immersion phase-change liquid-cooling temperature-control system, a self-redundant wide-range liquid-cooling distribution and temperature-control unit, a full-stack high-density fan-wall system for intelligent-computing centers, a large spray-type dry cooler and a magnetic-levitation phase-change multi-split cooling system targeting data-center PUE below 1.15; completed projects include an integrated cooling source for air-liquid hybrid data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (company): focus on building AI liquid-cooling business development, delivery and service capability in the North American market to meet the scaled landing of local customer orders, consolidate Southeast Asian business such as Malaysia and Thailand, and speed up the Middle East, South Asia and Europe; in data centers accelerate liquid-cooling temperature-control systems and modular integrated cooling-plus-power data-center infrastructure; and, given fast-growing compute and especially liquid-cooling demand, keep building capacity and accelerate construction of a new liquid-cooling manufacturing base
